title: rosa tomentella var. obtusifolia
intro: Rosa tomentella var. obtusifolia, commonly known as the Bear's Balm, is a perennial herb that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, as well as offering anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rosa tomentella var. obtusifolia include sedative, spasmolytic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal effects and contribute to its potential health benefits.
